newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals seen opening mixed.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals seen opening mixed.

text.p: New York precious metals futures were called to open mixed Wednesday although spot gold in the bullion market slipped to a new three-year low overnight.
COMEX April gold was called unchanged to off $0.50 from Tuesday's close of $346.40 an ounce. It traded from $346.30 to $344.30 on ACCESS.
In the bullion market, spot gold was quoted early at $343.10/60 after fixing at $343.15 in London this morning compared to Tuesday's New York close of $344.00/50.
Spot gold slid in Asia overnight as Chinese New Year slowed demand, analysts said. The retail Hong Kong tael market is closed for the holiday and will not reopen until Feb 10.
The dollar rose to a 47-month high against the yen overnight, pressuring demand for gold in other currencies.
COMEX gold stocks fell 40,293 ounces Tuesday to 796,781 ounces.
COMEX March silver was called unchanged to up 0.3 cent from Tuesday's close of $4.857. It traded from $4.810 to $4.865 on ACCESS.
COMEX silver stocks fell 119,339 ounces Tuesday to 195,330,170 ounces.
NYMEX April platinum was called unchanged to off $0.20 from the previous close of $355.00, with NYMEX March palladium called unchanged to $0.50 lower after finishing yesterday at $129.70.
